Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Shadow Dragon
Cards.Text:
After Shadow Dragon enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Shadow Dragon's abilities will not be copied.
Battle: Target an enemy Personality: Permanently give him Ninja and Shadowlands. Take control of him. Return control of him to his owner after the next time this game this ability is announced.
Open: If Shadow Dragon is dead: Bring it into play, paying all costs.

Cards.Name: The Dark Naga
Cards.Text:
After The Dark Naga enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Reaction: After another player targets The Dark Naga with an action: You may bow one of your Forests. If you did, negate The Dark Naga's destruction from the action's effects.
Battle: Target an enemy Personality: If he is Nonhuman, take control of him (he joins your army). If he is human, bow his unit. Destroy him before this turn ends.

Cards.Name: Yoritomo Sachina
Cards.Text:
Sachina's base ability will not be copied.
Political Limited: Once per game, target a Personality, pay Gold equal to his unit's total Gold Cost plus four, and bow Sachina: Take control of him. After the next time this game Sachina leaves play, give control of him to his owner.

Cards.Name: Goju Asuka
Cards.Text:
After Asuka enters play: You may give control of her to another player.
Asuka may not assign, and will not move, into a defending army.
After a Straighten Phase begins: Choose your bowed non-Spider Clan Personality. Negate his straightening this phase.
